verdict.rationale: Bento lets users define plain-English signals and alerts that run continuously against production traces. They fire in real time, get triaged into incidents with real-or-benign judgments, and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook. Nudges also run in shadow mode and graduate automatically. These are real autonomous background processes, but they are limited to monitoring and alerting rather than general user-defined automations. missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, scheduled or recurring task configuration, documented background-job controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Bento trains a signal on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your entire history
Write alerts in English. Bento groups fires into incidents and judges each one real or benign
Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
